name: The Glass Pits
description: A cluster of open pits where the sand has been fused into black glass, and old shafts lead down into the heat.

discovery.message: The sand ahead glitters black: fused glass, around the mouths of old mine shafts.

entrance.text: You climb down a shaft rimmed with black glass. The air gets hotter with every rung.

requirements.description: You need a light to go underground.

entrance.failure_text: Past the entrance it's black as pitch. You'd need a lit torch or lantern, or eyes that see in the dark, to go any further.

hazard.text: A sour smell hangs in the heat at the bottom of the shaft.
hazard.success_text: Gas. You hold your breath, keep your flame low and hurry through to clean air.
hazard.failure_text: The gas catches a spark and flares around you.

gas-burn.text: You stagger out of the flare, singed.

face.text: The first pit's face is streaked with iron and copper, baked hard by the heat below.

way-down.text: The tunnel beyond the face is choked with fused glass where something once burned hot enough to melt the rock. Nobody's getting deeper until it's cleared.

leave.text: You climb back up into the daylight.
